about.title: Turning Ideas Into Digital Experiences
about.heading: A Front-End Developer Passionate About Building Modern Web Applications
about.description1: I'm a Computer Engineering student and Front-End Developer focused on building modern, responsive, and user-friendly web applications.
about.description2: My main technologies include JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and modern front-end development tools. I enjoy transforming ideas and designs into clean and interactive user interfaces.
about.description3: I'm continuously learning and improving my skills through academic, personal, and real-world projects. I enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies, and creating web experiences that are both functional and visually appealing.
